title: Benchmark results — raw table export (Latency/$) — v1.1 runset
content:
INTERNAL — SANITIZED EXPORT (no prompt text, no per-request IDs)

Purpose:
- "Sheet-like" export of benchmark runs used to generate the public benchmark tables/charts.
- Includes per-run (replicate-level) aggregates by model/region/config.

Methodology reference:
- Latency-per-Dollar Public Benchmark — Methodology (Chat + Embeddings), v1.1 (2025-02-20)
- Key constraints used here: in-region runners, closed-loop concurrency, warmup=5m, measure=20m, cross-request caching disabled.

Harness + inputs:
- benchmark-lab_version: 0.14.3
- harness_git_sha: 9f2c1a7
- chat_dataset: public-chat-v1@sha256:7d1d…c42a
- embed_dataset: public-embed-v1@sha256:9a0b…13ef
- runtime_profile: public-benchmark-v1.1 (continuous_batching=on, prefix_kv_cache_across_requests=off)
- pricing_snapshot_id: price_2025-02-15_v3 (list price; no discounts/credits)

Units:
- p50/p95 latencies: milliseconds (ms), client-observed E2E; chat also includes TTFT p50 (ms)
- throughput_out_tok_s: output tokens/sec (chat)
- throughput_in_tok_s: input tokens/sec (embeddings)
- cost_per_1m_usd: effective cost per 1M tokens (basis depends on workload)
- latency_per_dollar_ms_usd_per_1k_tok: p50_e2e_ms * (cost_per_1m_usd / 1000)
  - Chat basis: per 1K OUTPUT tokens
  - Embeddings basis: per 1K INPUT tokens

Columns:
run_id,run_date_utc,workload,model_id,model_version,region,client_runner_region,concurrency,runtime_profile,quantization_profile,replicate,measure_minutes,requests_ok,requests_err,error_rate_pct,p50_ttft_ms,p50_e2e_ms,p95_e2e_ms,throughput_out_tok_s,throughput_in_tok_s,throughput_req_s,cost_per_1m_usd,cost_basis,latency_per_dollar_ms_usd_per_1k_tok,notes
